I really like this place, where they not only train my Cooper but have also given me good advice on how to have better control of his emotions.

My dogs are happy at DogDog. They go there to socialize, get tired out, learn, and above all, have fun. They are treated with great respect and affection. When I leave the city, they couldn't be in better hands. They also train with their trainers to help them adapt to civilization without losing sight of their nature and well-being. In short: We love DogDog.

Excellent trainers who always organize fun and educational activities for the dogs. They treat them with great patience and affection, and the care is excellent. Max is always very happy when he goes to Dog Dog; he comes back tired but very happy.
Milo Carvajal, I love DogDog, because I have an amazing time, they let me be myself!!! 🐾 …

The best place for your dog to socialize with other dogs. But above all, a place to learn how dogs think and improve their relationships. The entire staff is highly trained and they all care deeply for their dogs.
Excellent location...very clean and great service ☺️ 10 out of 10
Excellent advice for the care and coordination of your pet.

My experience with the hotel service was terrible. They are not trained to care for a large breed dog for an extended period. They made me pay for four classes with a trainer, two of which were simply walks. I constantly received complaints about bites and behaviors my dog ​​had never exhibited before staying with them. In the end, they returned my dog ​​earlier than expected, and a family member had to pick him up. They definitely did not provide me with any peace of mind during my trip, and I will not use their service again.
